name: atlas
description_en: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place
readme_excerpt: Download · Discord · Docs · Contributing · Issues Atlas Atlas is source control for coding agents. Every agent run produces checkpoints: commits are linked back to the session that made it alongside the prompts, tool calls, and reasoning. You see which agent did exactly what and why. Run Claude Code, Codex, Atlas's own agent, or anything from the ACP registry side by side against the same codebase, with shared memory so switching agents mid-task doesn't mean starting over. - Every commit, expla…
